name: VALORANT Champions 2026

map_pool_notes.Abyss: Returned to the pool right before Champions (replaced Breeze). Low recent practice volume for most teams, so map ratings are shrunk toward 0.
map_pool_notes.Summit: New map released 2026-06-24 (Act 4). Droppable walls on A, B and Mid. Only ~3 months of pro data.

group_format: GSL double elimination, all Bo3. Winners match winner = 1st seed, decider winner = 2nd seed.
playoff_format: 8-team double elimination. All Bo3 except Lower Bracket Final and Grand Final (Bo5).
playoff_seeding_note: Exact cross-group quarterfinal pairings were not confirmed at data time. Default assumes group winners face runners-up from a different group (A1-C2, B1-D2, C1-A2, D1-B2). Edit 'playoff_upper_quarterfinals' to change.
